name: Merav Ben David
background: Merav Ben David of Albany County won the 2026 Democratic primary for county commissioner and lost the November 2026 general election. Official 2026 general results and the Laramie Reporter's account of the incumbent commissioners' re-election show that the two 2026 commission seats were retained by Terri Jones and Pete Gosar. No public-record occupation, education, or military service was found in the official Albany County election results or the other public records reviewed for this Profile.
